why: EFFECT: "Your unit can make a normal move of up to 6", and must end that move within range of an objective." / "Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn." The gist keeps the move optional ("can make"), the 6" limit and the end-within-range-of-an-objective requirement ("ending within range"). The charge ban stays a separate clause, not tied to the move. Trigger "After shooting" = "when ... has shot". Nothing added or dropped.
